_comment: Stack-agnostic rules. Rendered into every project regardless of detected stack.

rules.title: No direct commits to the default branch
rules.rationale: A commit that lands without review skips every gate the project has — CI, review, and kaizen's own preflight. The cost of a branch is seconds; the cost of an unreviewed commit on the default branch is however long it takes someone to notice.

check.reason: requires branch protection state, not file content

rules.title: No new runtime dependencies without justification
rules.statement: No new runtime dependencies without justification.
rules.rationale: Every runtime dependency is permanent supply-chain surface, install weight, and a future upgrade obligation. Dev dependencies are cheap to remove; runtime ones end up in the shipped artifact and in every consumer's tree.

check.reason: justification is prose in a PR, not a file pattern

rules.title: No editing build output by hand
rules.statement: No editing generated or build output (`dist/`, `build/`, `target/`) by hand.
rules.rationale: A hand edit to generated output is erased by the next build, and in the meantime the source and the artifact disagree — which produces bugs that cannot be reproduced from the repository.

check.reason: requires diff history, not a static pattern

rules.title: Errors carry a type
rules.statement: **Errors are typed.** Throw domain-specific error types, not bare strings or generic exceptions.
rules.rationale: A caller can only handle an error it can distinguish. A thrown string or a generic exception forces every handler into message matching, which breaks the moment someone rewords the message.

rules.title: Tests must be order-independent
rules.statement: Tests must be order-independent — no test may depend on another having run first.
rules.rationale: Order dependence turns a test suite into a single fragile test. It breaks under parallel execution, under `--only`, and under any future runner change, and the failure blames the wrong test.

check.reason: detectable only by running the suite shuffled

rules.title: Mock external dependencies only
rules.statement: Mock **external** dependencies only (network, filesystem, third-party APIs). Never mock internal modules.
rules.rationale: Mocking an internal module tests the mock, not the code. It also freezes the internal shape, so any refactor breaks tests that were supposed to prove the refactor was safe.

check.reason: requires knowing which modules are internal
